# Fixture Residence Permit Eligibility (2026 edition)

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Eligibility

Applicants must be at least 18 years old. Applicants must hold a valid passport. Applicants must have a registered address in Fixture City.

## 2 Fees

The application fee for a residence permit is 55 euros. Applicants under 25 pay a reduced fee of 30 euros.

## 3 Changes in 2026

The 2026 edition raised the standard application fee from 40 euros to 55 euros and added the registered address requirement.
